API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIWorkload GroupsWorkload Group Resource Get Workload Groups
Workload Group Resource Get Workload Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/workloadGroups

Gets the list of workload groups configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. You can configure the workload groups as criteria in various policies including Data Loss Prevention, URL Filtering, SSL Inspection, and Firewall Filtering rules. To learn more, see About Workload Groups and Configuring Workload Groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250 and the maximum size is 1,000.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
200
401
403
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)

id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the workload group

name
string

The name of the workload group

description
string

The description of the workload group

expressionJson
object
expression
string

The workload group expression containing tag types, tags, and their relationships.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the workload group was last modified

object
